verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop SaaS with Teams usage and audit data, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions of any kind. Audit logs and API-based reporting are adjacent data features, not AI analysis, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
